// diagnostic

E3405

A `debug` trace is left at `{site}`.

What

A `debug` trace is left at `{site}`.

Why

`debug(value)` is a development trace: it prints while you run, test, or interpret a program and adds no effect, so a shipped artifact (`jet build`) or a release-profile build must not contain it.

Fix

Remove the `debug(…)` wrapper and keep the expression; `jet fix` applies this edit.
